checkpoints.description: [1/1] Bound refusal retries and publish real hop fuel costs

impact_assessment.why: Bounded retries stop an unaffordable gate being retried forever, and a published hop price stops jumps the tank cannot pay for
impact_assessment.benefits: Refusals become a meaningful signal: long runs drop from 110 to 21, all one-off or genuinely gated
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains a mapping; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: page-memory retry budget only
impact_assessment.mitigation: three-attempt budget with stale cooldown cleanup, cost derived from the engine jump formula, tests and a 2,000-step measurement

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Repeatable refuel plus state-driven resume and insurance recovery

impact_assessment.why: One-shot refuel left the tank dry, and a destroyed hull stops the clock, so long campaigns froze with no path forward
impact_assessment.benefits: Runs advance through death and pause states instead of spinning, and fuel upkeep works for the whole campaign
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: page-memory cooldown only
impact_assessment.mitigation: cooldown per route, state-driven recovery before any other action, measured over 10 rounds, seven tests across three classes

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Bank oversized drone hauls in part, collect on cooldown, and never cap maintenance selling

impact_assessment.why: A 1,256-unit haul behind a 40-volume hold could never be collected, so credits and mining contracts were stranded
impact_assessment.benefits: The economy loop pays out: 18 claims and 56k credits in six rounds instead of one claim and zero credits
impact_assessment.risks: contract: collect may now succeed partially where it used to refuse; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: banked amount bounded by actual units and free volume, credits separated from cargo, existing full-hold pin updated to the split, new no-room refusal pinned
